'''Tel IV''' was the fourth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tel Minor system/Legends|Tel Minor system]], located in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It was a ball of rock.<ref name="FBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the [[Tel Minor system/Legends|Tel Minor system]] was invented to account for discrepancies between the different sources,<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref> in this case the planet Tel IV.
